description: UltimateCustomGear is a data-driven NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that lets server owners, modpack creators, and players add fully custom armor sets, weapons, tools, food, items, blocks, and fluids — all through simple JSON files. No coding required.

mods.name: Ultimate Custom Gear
mods.description: Ultimate Custom Gear is a data-driven mod that allows server owners and modpack creators to add custom armor sets, weapons, tools, food items, blocks and fluids via simple JSON files. No coding required. Supports custom stats, held effects, set bonuses, per-piece armor values, layered damage resistances, 3D armor models via GeckoLib, custom textures, transparent armor, mob drops with Looting support, every vanilla recipe type plus passthrough recipes for other mods, tag integration and tag patching, distributable content packs, and multiplayer content verification.
